function.name: auditSite
function.description: Run a comprehensive GEO/SEO site audit for AI visibility analysis. Alias: anoteros_logos. Executes via the MCP transport at /api/mcp.

function.name: getGraph
function.description: Build a knowledge graph with entities and relationships from a page. Executes via the MCP transport at /api/mcp.

url.description: The website URL to extract a knowledge graph from.

function.name: predictCitation
function.description: Predict citation probability across AI platforms for a page. Executes via the MCP transport at /api/mcp.

platform.description: Target AI platform (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity).

designTools.name: code_execution
designTools.note: Sandboxed code execution (isolated-vm). Requires a native binding unavailable in production serverless; not callable.

designTools.name: federated_authority_boost
designTools.note: Requires a live peer mesh; unavailable in production serverless.

legacyAliases.note: Legacy AID transition aliases; delegate to the canonical /api/auth AIP identity service. Not the canonical identity path.

subsystems.name: mesh
subsystems.note: Requires a persistent libp2p host; a running swarm cannot run on stateless serverless functions.

subsystems.name: pbft
subsystems.note: Consensus needs multiple long-lived peers; not runnable on stateless serverless.

subsystems.name: ccc
subsystems.note: No persistent shared ledger in production.

subsystems.name: watermark
subsystems.note: Deterministic UCPT watermark extraction/verification runs in-function via /api/verify.
